lemmas.primary_translation: to zoom in / to focus attention on

definitions.text: justere innstilling på et (skjerm)bilde eller kamera slik at visse motiver blir større og flere detaljer trer fram innenfor bilderuten
definitions.translation: to adjust the setting of a screen image or camera so that particular subjects become larger and more details become visible within the frame
to turn one's attention toward something

examples.no: boka zoomer inn på kriminalitet blant unge
examples.en: the book zooms in on crime among young people

definitions.text: bringe i søkelyset, konsentrere oppmerksomheten om
definitions.translation: to bring into focus; to concentrate attention on
